PMI describes DHIS2 as the Ministry of Health and Child Care's system: donors and partners have very limited access to it, the ministry circulates no routine monthly DHIS2 report, and the malaria programme shares its data with PMI at bilateral meetings. The document's published year is used.

PMI states that electronic health records designed for deployment at each health facility, from which patient-level data would be aggregated into DHIS2, had been piloted in a small number of select districts, with no count given, and that the country continued to rely mainly on the existing paper-based HMIS. PMI gives full digitisation of the HMIS through facility electronic health records as the current strategic direction of the Ministry of Health and Child Care, and says it is unclear whether the very substantial resources needed for scale-up will be made available.
